connector.name: KeepFlash Agent Access
connector.registryDescription: Search, read, cite, create, and safely update a user's private KeepFlash knowledge library.
connector.summary: Hosted at keepflash.com over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the dante-is-shipping account. Treat it as community software and read the source before granting access to anything sensitive.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.
